content.value: Hot metal of composition 0.8% Si, 0.2% P, 0.25% Mn, 4% C and in house steel scarp is refined in a converter to produce steel of composition 0.2% C and rest iron. During refining scarp is charged whose amount is 20% of hot metal. Pure oxygen is blown. The composition of slag is CaO 54%, FeO 18% and MnO 2.5 % with ${ \mathrm { C a O / S i O } } _ { 2 } { = } 3 . 5 .$ Exit gases analyses 20% $C O _ { 2 }$ and 80% CO. Calculate amount of steel, slag, oxygen and waste gases per ton hot metal.
